description: Saves the default look of every email: theme colors (background, surface, text), buttons (button_style solid or outline, button_shape pill or rounded), the dark-mode logo (logo_dark) and the info bar, a dark band across the top (for example free shipping). A single campaign can override any of these with blocks.theme and blocks.info_bar. Fields you leave out stay as they are; info_bar: null removes the bar; a color "" goes back to the default. Text needs 4.5:1 contrast with the surface; campaign_preview warns when it does not. logo_dark is a light-colored version of the logo for readers in dark mode (Apple Mail, iOS Mail, Outlook.com); store it first with email_image_upload (a PNG with a transparent background works best) and pass the returned url; "" removes it. Uses no quota and sends nothing. Only save what the person approved. Example: {"theme": {"surface": "#ffffff", "text": "#27272a", "button_style": "outline", "button_shape": "pill"}, "info_bar": {"text": "Free shipping on orders over $99", "url": "https://shop.example/shipping"}} Requires API key scope: draft.

text.description: Short line, for example "Free shipping on orders over $99".

url.description: Where a click on the bar goes.

info_bar.description: Default info bar for every email, or null to remove it.

button_shape.description: pill or rounded; null goes back to the brand radius.

button_style.description: solid or outline; null goes back to solid.

logo_dark.description: Logo for dark mode: an https image URL from email_image_upload, light-colored so it reads on a dark background. "" removes it.

name: brand_set_theme
title: Save email look
